text:
incident-bot: ALERT: model-alpha-3 (eu-west-1) elevated 5xx rate detected. 18% 5xx over the last 10m, p95 latency jump to 2.1s. Group: canary routing (~8% traffic). Auto-escalating to incidents channel.

Maya R (oncall): I'm on it. pulling up dashboards now. anyone seen related deploys in the last hour?

Sam K: Not from serving infra. Last deployment was a small canary model push 40m ago (alpha-3).

Anya P: Confirming errors are 502 from the runtime, traces show repeated kv-cache misses and session eviction logs.

Marco L: Hm, we saw a similar pattern with a quant kernel mismatch last month. Could be the new attention kernel landing on this model.

Maya R (oncall): Customer impact? which keys are hitting it hard?

OpsBot: Top affected API keys: acct-11c, acct-88b (both high-volume chat customers). acct-11c request rate spiked 4x in last 15m.

Jules (Support): FYI, acct-11c has a high-touch customer success contact; preparing standby message if we need to throttle.

Maya R (oncall): Ok plan: 1) temporarily disable alpha-3 routing in eu-west-1 canary 2) shift canary traffic to model-stable-v2 3) apply emergency per-key soft-quotas for heavy keys while we verify. Anyone object?

Sam K: +1, do it. We should snapshot runtime logs before the change for postmortem.

Anya P: I'll watch inference errors and KV cache metrics. If error rate doesn't drop after rollback, we escalate to runtime team for hotpatch.

Maya R (oncall): Executing disable now. This will set routing weight 0 for alpha-3 (eu-west-1) canary and rehome to stable variant.

Maya R (oncall): Running command:
```bash
redwoodctl traffic update --region eu-west-1 --variant alpha-3 --weight 0 --note "emergency disable due 502 spike"
redwoodctl traffic update --region eu-west-1 --variant stable-v2 --weight +8 --note "shift canary traffic"
```

OpsBot: Routed: alpha-3 weight -> 0. stable-v2 weight -> +8. Change propagated to edge routers in ~12s.

incident-bot: Event recorded: incident-2250004321, severity: high, auto-paged oncall.

Anya P: Error rate dropping already. 5xx now 3.1% at p95 latency 220ms. KV cache eviction logs quieting.

Maya R (oncall): Great. Now applying soft quotas to top noisy keys to avoid quick re-surge while we stabilize.

Maya R (oncall): Commands:
```json
{"action":"quota.update","key":"acct-11c","rate_limit":"60req/min","note":"emergency soften"}
{"action":"quota.update","key":"acct-88b","rate_limit":"120req/min","note":"emergency soften"}
```

OpsBot: Soft quotas applied. acct-11c now limited to 60req/min with 10s burst. acct-88b limited to 120req/min.

Jules (Support): Notifying acct-11c CS and listing mitigation steps. Drafting a short message: "We've temporarily routed your traffic to our stable model and applied a protective rate limit. You may see slightly different latencies; we're working to restore full capacity."

Sam K: Meanwhile, I'll collect logs and dump a runtime profile for the alpha-3 variant for the last 30m. If we confirm a kernel compatibility regression, we should demote alpha-3 from canary entirely.

Anya P: Profiling results: multiple repeated errors in the attention kernel initialization path for sequence lengths >1024. Stack shows mismatch in quantized kernel selection when run on T4 family in eu-west-1.

Marco L: That aligns with my suspicion. I recommend we mark alpha-3 as quarantined and add a deploy blocker until we patch the kernel selection logic.

Maya R (oncall): Decision: 1) Keep alpha-3 disabled globally for canary traffic. 2) Open incident ticket and tag runtime kernel owners. 3) Rollback canary flag in org to prevent future automatic rollouts. 4) Timeline: hold for 2h and monitor.

incident-bot: Incident ticket created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3217 (auto-populated). Severity: P1. Owners: @Marco L, @Anya P, @Sam K.

Sam K: I'll prepare a quick hotfix branch to force quant kernel mapping to the safe path; if we can verify in staging we can reintroduce alpha-3 behind a stricter canary.

Maya R (oncall): Handoff note for follow-up: If no regression in 2h and error <1% for 30m, we can consider re-enabling alpha-3 behind 0.5% traffic and additional tracing. Otherwise keep disabled and proceed with kernel patch.

Jules (Support): Sent notification to acct-11c CS. Also pinged enterprise slack for any other customers seeing differences.

Anya P: Creating eval run to compare stable-v2 vs alpha-3 outputs for a subset of prompts to detect quality drift before reintroducing.

Marco L: Also enabling short-term extra logging for kernel selection path; avoid logging PII.

Maya R (oncall): Close loop: 5xx dropped to 0.6% after shift, p95 180ms. Keeping soft quotas for 45m. I'm stepping off page at 08:00 UTC; Sam will be the primary contact for next hour.

Sam K: Taking over. I'll monitor and coordinate rollback patch if needed.

incident-bot: RESOLVE candidate: monitoring period started. No further automated pages for this alert channel until conditions breach thresholds.

Jules (Support): Closing customer comms once stable for 30m.

Maya R (oncall): Thanks everyone. Postmortem owners: Sam K and Anya P. Please include timeline, root cause hypothesis (kernel mapping on quant path), mitigation steps, and a rollback playbook for future canary model issues.

Sam K: Will do. I'll upload logs and the profile to INF-3217 and add the rollback commands we used.

Anya P: Leaving final note: Do not re-promote alpha-3 until kernel fix and a successful staging run validated on eu-west-1 hardware matrix.

Marco L: Filing a follow-up RFC for safer kernel-selection testing in our CI.

incident-bot: Incident INF-3217 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

(ends)
